role: Newly authored query-first development transfer checks; not a family-disjoint held-out set or production sample

queries.question: If I tie two surfaces in Abaqus, can they subsequently separate or slide relative to each other, or is a contact interaction needed for that behavior?
What is the difference between kinematic and distributing coupling when a load must be transferred from a reference point while allowing the coupled surface to deform?
In an Abaqus/Explicit quasi-static analysis, why can excessive mass scaling change the physical response even when it reduces the number of stable time increments?
Why do nearly incompressible materials often need hybrid solid elements in Abaqus/Standard, and what additional variable does the hybrid formulation introduce?
For a two-dimensional plane strain model, which out-of-plane strain components are constrained, and can the out-of-plane normal stress still be nonzero?
Why can first-order reduced-integration elements exhibit hourglass modes, and what does hourglass control attempt to prevent?
Why can nodal extrapolated stress values differ from stresses at integration points, especially in a region with a steep stress gradient?
Why can a few very small elements control the stable time increment and increase the runtime of an Abaqus/Explicit analysis?
